jobs.title: Quality Control Officer
jobs.role: Support routine QC testing of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and chemical intermediates in line with approved cGMP testing methods and pharmacopeial standards.
jobs.duties: Perform chromatographic (HPLC/GC) and wet chemical testing, maintain audit-ready laboratory records, report deviations, and collaborate with QA on out-of-specification investigations.
jobs.profile: M.Sc. Chemistry / B.Pharm with 2-4 years of analytical testing experience in a regulatory-approved API facility.

jobs.title: Production Chemist
jobs.role: Manage shift operations in bulk API synthesis and reaction suites under the plant operations manager.
jobs.duties: Execute batch manufacturing records (BMR), monitor critical process parameters (temperature, pressure, agitation), ensure PPE compliance, and execute seamless shift handovers.
jobs.profile: B.Sc. / M.Sc. Chemistry or Diploma in Chemical Engineering with plant-floor synthesis experience.

jobs.title: EHS Executive
jobs.role: Champion environmental compliance, occupational health, and process safety standards across operational units.
jobs.duties: Conduct safety audits, lead hazard identification (HAZOP) reviews, track effluent treatment plant (ETP) metrics, manage work permits, and coordinate regulatory filings.
jobs.profile: Degree / Diploma in Industrial Safety or Environmental Engineering with 3+ years in chemical / pharma manufacturing.

jobs.title: Senior Research Chemist — Process R&D
jobs.role: Lead synthetic route scouting, reaction optimization, and technology transfer for generic APIs and pipeline molecules.
jobs.duties: Design non-infringing synthetic pathways, optimize reaction stoichiometry to improve yields and minimize solvent waste, and prepare tech-transfer packages for commercial manufacturing.
jobs.profile: Ph.D. or M.Sc. in Organic Chemistry with 4-7 years in API process development and route optimization.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
jobs.role: Prepare, compile, and maintain Drug Master Files (DMF / CEP) for international regulatory agencies.
jobs.duties: Author Module 3 quality sections, respond to regulatory deficiency letters, track post-approval changes, and support customer audits.
jobs.profile: M.Pharm / M.Sc. with 5+ years of experience in USFDA / EDQM filings.
